Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Global Hexagonal Elm Dining Table, 47.2"W, Natural Wood
Colors: Natural
Materials: elm
Serve up a side dish of amazing style to any guests who dine at this six-sided table. Handcrafted of sustainably sourced materials, the table top and pedestal add distinctive rustic, modern and global touches to your home. 47.2"W x 47.2"D x 29.9"H Sustainably sourced elm wood A handsome piece that blends with modern, rustic or industrial decor Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
